record.title: India excludes selected Bangladeshi imports from land ports
record.scope: May 17: garments barred at every land port; listed foods, drinks, cotton waste, plastic/PVC goods and furniture barred at named regional ports. June 27 and August 11 amendments added specified flax/jute fibres, yarns, fabrics, cordage and sacks/bags to all-land-port prohibitions.
record.crossings: All land ports for garments and later specified fibre/jute products; northeast states plus Changrabandha/Fulbari for other May-listed goods.
record.movement: Specified Bangladeshi garments and regional import categories from May 17; additional flax/jute fibre, yarn, fabric, cordage and sack/bag categories from June 27 and August 11.
record.exceptions: May notification exempts fish, LPG, edible oil, crushed stone and Bangladesh transit exports to Nepal/Bhutan. Named seaports remain permitted; June/August additions route through Nhava Sheva, with Nepal/Bhutan transit exempt but re-export into India prohibited.
record.imposing_authority: India Directorate General of Foreign Trade
record.enforcement: Published import-port eligibility rule; this record establishes prohibition, not measured compliance at each gate.
record.consequences: Permitted routing shifted to named seaports for garments; costs not quantified.
record.status_observation: Closure evidenced as of 2025-05-17; subsequent status unresolved
record.official_rationale: Notification regulates port eligibility for selected imports; motive not established in instrument.
record.context: Notification regulates port eligibility for selected imports; motive not established in instrument.
record.uncertainty: Selective goods restriction, not all freight or people. June and August additions are within-regime scope changes. Gazette, reproductions and consolidated schedule are one documentary origin; no measured gate-level compliance or final repeal established.
